messages:
deploy-bot: Release paused for promo 2026.03.20 18:10 UTC — preflight detected env parity failure between staging and prod. Blocking reason: feature flag encoding mismatch for "enable_new_routing". Staging: boolean true/false. Prod: string "true"/"false". See diff below and release notes impact.

maria: ack, looking. where's the preflight log?

deploy-bot: /preflight/output/2367102222.json attached. quick snippet:
```
staging:  enable_new_routing: true
prod:     enable_new_routing: "true"
```

devon: omg this explains the 500s we saw in prod during canary yesterday. Some services parse as bool, others expect string.

samir: is this from the new configlib change that preserves types? We rolled that out in staging two days ago.

maria: yes, configlib 1.4.0 started serializing feature flags as native types. Ops backfilled prod flags as strings via the old UI.

olivia: consequence: when gateway does strict schema validation it rejects requests with mismatched type. That's why fallback to model-variant failed.

devon: immediate plan: pin the service to v2026.03.17 which still used configlib 1.3.x, or normalize prod flags to boolean. Which is safer in the change window?

maria: change window in 2h. Normalizing prod flags requires a db backfill + restart of 3 infra services -> riskier. Pin and rollback is faster.

samir: agree. pin to v2026.03.17 for the release and then schedule a dev-only rollout of the configlib change next week with a migration job.

maria: will open a rollback PR and update release notes. Note: pinning will keep new telemetry missing for routing experiment; call that out.

devon: @maria can you also add a note in the release changelog: "ROLLBACK: configlib type change deferred; feature flag encoding parity fix pending"

maria: yup. drafting now. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/4823 : reverting configlib bump in runtime image and adding a preflight guard for flag types.

olivia: also add a postmortem action to add a preflight that checks flag types across envs (and a linter for tfvars/secret exports).

samir: +1. recommend we also add a short-lived alert that fires if any env has heterogenous types for the same key.

deploy-bot: Releasebot note: promotion remains paused. Run `./scripts/pin-release 2026.03.17` to perform pin (requires release-admin).

maria: executing pin now. will push rollback image tag and update rollout config.

maria: done — pinned, canary promoted back to staging-only. I updated release notes and added a line to the change window doc.

devon: thanks. leaving this thread open until postmortem actions are scheduled.

olivia: I'll own the migration ticket to normalize flags in prod and add a migration runbook.

samir: I'll schedule the lint and preflight work.

maria: one more thing: add an entry to the release notes for customer-facing comms? probably not necessary — internal only since no user-facing behavior changed.

devon: agreed. tagging for follow-up: @oncall-bot for the next 72h watch and @release-manager for timeline. :eyes:

deploy-bot: note: next attempt will re-run preflight checks. Reopen thread if anything flips.

maria: closing for now, will link postmortem when available.
